# YDF Oblique Forests — Research Fork

> This document covers only the oblique random forest training path in this fork,
> not the full YDF project.

## Overview

Research fork of Yggdrasil Decision Forests focused on accelerating oblique
(sparse) random forest training. Oblique splits use linear combinations of
features instead of single-feature thresholds.

## Key Areas

- Oblique split finding: `yggdrasil_decision_forests/learner/decision_tree/oblique.cc`
- Tree growth (BFS iterative): `yggdrasil_decision_forests/learner/decision_tree/training.cc`
- RF training loop: `yggdrasil_decision_forests/learner/random_forest/random_forest.cc`
- Custom per-function profiling: `yggdrasil_decision_forests/utils/parallel_chrono.h`

## Benchmarks

Experimental instrumentation lives in `benchmarks/`:
- `benchmarks/src/` — scripts: e2e runtime suite, CHRONO profiling driver, breakeven experiments
- `benchmarks/data/` — datasets: OpenML CC18 (35 tasks), HIGGS, SUSY, epsilon, synthetic trunk
- `benchmarks/results/` — committed output: e2e runtime logs, accuracy logs, per-function CSVs by CPU

## Build

Bazel project. Default optimized: `bazel build -c opt //<target>`.
CHRONO profiling: `--config=multithreaded_chrono_profile`.

## Details

- llms-full.txt: Extended documentation with architecture and file reference
- AGENTS.md: Instructions for AI coding agents working in this repo
